fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) has shifted to a capital-intensive business model while investing multiple trillions of dollars in AI data center construction, with stock price down 30% from spring highs.
fields.summary_ko.1: Alphabet is projected to reach peak cash burn of $8 billion in 2027; however, free cash flow is expected to turn positive again from 2029 onwards, with current cash position of $56B and marketable securities of $209B providing sufficient financial foundation.
